lines.en: I shift a step at a time on root feet.

lines.zh: 镀金的树皮在光下发亮。
lines.en: My gilded bark gleams in the light.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下金屑。
lines.en: Gold flakes trail where I walk.

lines.zh: 树干一弯，我就迈出一步。
lines.en: My trunk bends and a step follows.

lines.zh: 我绕着林间空地慢慢走。
lines.en: I circle the glade slowly.

lines.zh: 根从土里拔出，又扎下去。
lines.en: Roots pull up and drive back down.

lines.zh: 我走得比树长得快一点。
lines.en: I move a little faster than trees grow.
My branches scrape other trees.

lines.zh: 金箔一样的叶子落了一路。
lines.en: Gold-leaf leaves fall along the way.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，土就松一块。
lines.en: Each step loosens a patch of soil.
I head deeper into the wood.
Heavy steps, slow and sure.

lines.zh: 我站着，和别的树没两样。
lines.en: Standing, I pass for another tree.
Gilded rings grow inside me.
I do not breathe, yet leaves stir.

lines.zh: 树冠上的鸟以为我是树。
lines.en: Birds think my crown is a tree.

lines.zh: 我在听根系下面的水声。
lines.en: I listen to water under the roots.

lines.zh: 我站了很久，落了一层金。
lines.en: Standing long, I gather a coat of gold.

lines.zh: 这片林子的年龄，我数得清。
lines.en: I can count this wood's years.

lines.zh: 我的树心是空的，也很沉。
lines.en: My heartwood is hollow and heavy.
Wind comes. I sway one branch.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一座小山。
lines.en: I take myself for a hill.
Gold dust slides off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在等季节换一次颜色。
lines.en: I wait for the season to change color.
Roots reach slowly underground.
No hurry. There is time.

lines.zh: 这片空地，我站了几百年。
lines.en: I have stood in this glade centuries.

lines.zh: 有虫在我皮下走，我不介意。
lines.en: Insects walk under my bark. I do not mind.
I store light in my heartwood.

lines.zh: 静下来，我更像一座林子。
lines.en: Still, I am more like a forest.
My roots are plated in gold.
This tree looks back.

lines.zh: 你手里那把斧子，收起来。
lines.en: Put that axe away.
Do not touch the gilded parts.

lines.zh: 我在这里站着，比你先来。
lines.en: I stood here before you came.
An axe slides off gilded bark.
Do not cut me. My memory is long.
I keep this wood.
Look up. You cannot see my top.

lines.zh: 我树皮上的金，不是给你刮的。
lines.en: The gold on my bark is not for scraping.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，根就动一下。
lines.en: One step closer and a root moves.

lines.zh: 我很少开口，你运气不好。
lines.en: I rarely speak. Bad luck for you.
One gold leaf falls.
A cut opens in my bark.
I sway. The roots hold.
I keep that in a ring.
The wood split. Not broken.
A broken branch, I'll recall a year.
Gold dust falls like rain.
Pain is one of a tree's words.
Your cut is shallow.
Still here. Roots still gripping.
Fertilizer? Set it farther off.
Showing me gold?
I carry more gold than you do.
Leave the water. Pour it on my roots.
Pour water on my roots instead.

lines.zh: 这块木头是从我身上来的吗？
lines.en: Did that wood come from me?
Set the axe down, step off my roots.
Bone meal does little for me.

lines.zh: 金光晃眼，你举得太高了。
lines.en: The glint is blinding. Too high.
This offering belongs to my roots.
You hit my trunk and fall back.
I am a wall that breathes.
Roots this deep don't budge.
Your shoulder knocks down a gold leaf.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，落了几片叶。
lines.en: I sway; a few leaves fall.
You snapped a fine root.

lines.zh: 碰撞在我这儿就是一声闷响。
lines.en: A bump is only a dull thud to me.
You withdraw. I stay put.
Bark is harder than you think.
I sway and gold dust falls on you.
Between trees, it is the wind.

lines.zh: 我的种子落在很远的土里。
lines.en: My seeds fall far from here.
I speak of that once in centuries.
Odd question to ask a tree.
Few of my kind in this wood.

lines.zh: 花粉飘起来的时候，你避开。
lines.en: When the pollen drifts, step aside.
My flowers do not open for the living.

lines.zh: 根与根连在一起，就够了。
lines.en: Root joined to root is enough.
Stop. My bark is furrowing.
The wind will carry that away.

lines.zh: 地上的金屑，我收回根边。
lines.en: I draw the gold flakes back to my roots.
I kick your fallen axe aside.
Leaves return to soil. That is the rule.
I hook it up with a branch.
This is pressing on my root.
Move it aside — don't block my roots.
That fallen fruit comes back to me.
I keep nothing you dropped.

lines.zh: 我的根把土拱起来，露出它。
lines.en: My roots lift the soil and expose it.
Picking things up is not my habit.

lines.zh: 斧子举起来了，我看见了。
lines.en: The axe is up. I saw.
My roots start to move.
You have stepped under my crown.

lines.zh: 这一下，为那些被砍的树。
lines.en: This is for the trees already felled.
My roots picked you out underground.
There is strength under this bark.

lines.zh: 你想砍一棵会走路的树？
lines.en: Cut a tree that walks?
I raise a limb your way.

lines.zh: 你听见树根的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear the roots?
Gold turns the axe too.

lines.zh: 金叶的影子，落到你身上。
lines.en: Gilded leaf-shade falls on you.
Roots surface at your feet.
You retreat; my crown turns too.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我待得比你久。
lines.en: No chase. I outlast you.
The soil under you loosens.
I lower a limb.

lines.zh: 你听得见木头的响声吗？
lines.en: Hear the wood creak?

lines.zh: 这片林子里的根都听我。
lines.en: Every root here answers to me.
Don't test the gilded side with a pick.
One step more and the roots close.
A limb sweeps and you go down.
A root whips up your leg.
Heavier than the trunk itself.
Gold flakes fly with that blow.
Your axe is knocked away.
My bark rakes your hands.

lines.zh: 我慢慢砸下去，你没躲开。
lines.en: I bring it down slowly, and you miss it.

lines.zh: 这一击让地上多了个坑。
lines.en: That leaves a dent in the ground.
Two steps back, and the root follows.
I do not shout. Wood does not shout.

lines.zh: 这棵树以前不长在这儿。
lines.en: This tree was not here before.
A golden tree joins the wood.
Roots arch out of the soil.

lines.zh: 树皮上的金慢慢亮起来。
lines.en: Gold on the bark slowly brightens.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很长的木头响。
lines.en: A long creak of wood.
The leaf pile shifts.

lines.zh: 我从地上升起来，像长出来。
lines.en: I rise as if growing.

lines.zh: 这片空地上，多了一棵树。
lines.en: One more tree in the glade.

lines.zh: 镀金的部分在暗里发光。
lines.en: The gilding glows in the dark.
Birds leave the crown.
My roots take new soil.
I will keep watch here.
Fire blackens a patch of my bark.

lines.zh: 我倒下去，砸断了三棵树。
lines.en: I fall and break three trees.
Water soaks my roots. I move slowly.
The blast tears off a limb.
An arrow lodges in my bark.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的叶子变黄了。
lines.en: Magic yellows my leaves.
No water, and my leaf tips curl.

lines.zh: 雷劈开了我的一半天冠。
lines.en: Lightning splits half my crown.
Roots find nothing in the void.
